name: Social Gummies
tagline: Real fruit purée, no cannabis aftertaste.
imageAlt: Sherpa Social Gummies pouch, Strawberry Bellini flavour, 10 mg
description: Strawberry Bellini Social Gummies are built for the moments that call for good company: meeting friends, easing into a party, or just adding a little spark to your day. Each gummy pairs nano-emulsified THC with terpinolene and pinene. Terpinolene brings an uplifting, energizing lift, and pinene sharpens focus and alertness, together supporting the easy, engaged feeling that keeps conversation flowing.
notes: Give it 45 minutes before deciding you need a second one.
Made in San Antonio, Texas from sustainably sourced hemp.

name: Sleep Gummies
tagline: Myrcene and linalool, blended to help you actually stay asleep.
imageAlt: Sherpa Sleep Gummies pouch, Blackberry Lemonade flavour, 10 mg
description: Blackberry Lemonade Sleep Gummies are built to help you unwind, not stay up. Each gummy pairs nano-emulsified THC with myrcene and linalool, two terpenes associated with deep relaxation, easing tension and quieting the mind so sleep holds through the night rather than just the first hour.
notes: Best taken 30 to 60 minutes before bed.
Made in San Antonio, Texas from sustainably sourced hemp.
Uses pectin, not gelatin — no animal products.

name: Basecamp Seltzer
tagline: About 15 minutes, not the 45 to 90 you would wait on a gummy.
imageAlt: Sherpa THC Seltzer cans, four flavours in a row
heroAlt: A single Sherpa Basecamp Seltzer can, 10 mg THC
description: Nano-emulsified so the THC disperses in water rather than sitting in oil, which is what makes the onset fast and, more usefully, predictable. Sparkling water, natural flavour, THC. Nothing else.
notes: The flagship can is 10 mg. The same seltzer is made from 5 mg up to 100 mg.
